title: Wander: The Cult of Barnacle Bay - Update
body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WNFEf_ZwNFw

A short piece of housekeeping from Daniel (@dungeondive), and a more interesting document than it looks. The **Wander: The Cult of Barnacle Bay** playthrough is running long, so he'll finish the current scenario and the next one off-camera and return for the campaign's first boss battle — the fight he actually wants on film.

The reasons are cheerfully mundane and very familiar to anyone who films games at home: the hobby room has space for exactly one game set up at a time, and the dining table, his usual overflow, is currently occupied by his wife's sewing project.

The rest is a report from Dungeon Siege West, where he'd spent the week running games. He notes it draws a different crowd than a typical board game convention — darker, because of the music side of it — and he's hoping the organisers can secure better facilities for open gaming next year. He also met the people behind Lurker Magazine, a perfect-bound black-and-white quarterly at around twenty dollars an issue that ships with a seven-inch record, and is mulling contributing written reviews. Which leads to the real news buried at the end: viewers have been asking for dungeon synth coverage, and he's considering it — a subculture, as he puts it, of a subculture of a subculture.

----

This is the channel visibly deciding to widen. Which side-interest of a creator you follow turned out to be the best thing they did?
